body_wire_migration.reason: The generic connection adapter strips only the first body. prefix. A body.data object serializes the required nested Asana wrapper; ordinary recipe body.data.field keys serialize as literal dotted JSON keys.

auth.selected: Bearer personal access token or OAuth access token through the enrolled Asana connection

exclusions.reason: The route accepts multipart/form-data with a file part and up to 100 MB of binary content. The bounded REST binding has no multipart encoder or file-part contract, so a JSON or text substitute would not execute the documented operation.

Each batch action accepts an arbitrary relative_path plus get, post, put, delete, patch, or head. Exposing that body would bypass the pack's per-operation method/path grants and turn one approved operation into an arbitrary Asana API passthrough.
